published.method: Blackstone's own model using historical index returns from September 2004 to December 2025, not an actual fund or plan.

notes: Uses indices, not real funds: indices carry no fund-level fees or wrapper costs.
Private credit history before 2019 includes Blackstone's own estimate for leverage and fees.
Holds the 20% private slice for life, which assumes the plan can rebalance despite redemption limits.
Different index choices or timing would change the result, as the paper itself notes.
